title: Mixing: Getting Closer by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The song ‘Getting Closer’ was mixed in stereo for Wings’ seventh studio album Back To The Egg on 22 March 1979.

This day’s work remained unused, however, and the final mix was created on 23 March.
